stem: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a disease of the joints in the human body.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
RA is classed as an auto-immune disease where the immune system treats some self antigens as non-self.

Explain what is meant by the term *non-self antigens*.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem:
The symptoms of RA include inflammation of the joints which causes pain and difficulty in movement of the joint.

The inflammation is triggered by a chemical known as TNF-$\alpha$, produced by macrophages.

One approach to the treatment of RA is by the use of monoclonal antibody against TNF-$\alpha$.

Fig. 3.1 is a diagram of an antibody molecule.
